children.text: Replace this photo: a lesson room, with an instrument in frame. Open Edit layout at the top left and drop a photo on this frame. You can change the text there too.
Children and adults. A first lesson, or someone coming back to an instrument.
The lesson follows their goal and their pace. The point is being able to play, or to sing.
Beginners, and people coming back, are welcome
A recital when there is something to play
Replace this photo from Edit layout at the top left. Drop a photo on this frame, and edit the text there too. Photo idea: a student at the piano.
Classical or the songs they already like. The basics are taught properly either way.

A song with a voice, or playing in a band. Start from a song they want to play.
Replace this photo from Edit layout at the top left. Drop a photo on this frame, and edit the text there too. Photo idea: a voice lesson or a drum lesson.
Singing, or hitting the kit. The lesson is about doing it, not only talking about it.
The lesson moves at their pace, toward their own goal.
Learn the songs they already love
A song they chose is a better assignment than one they don't care about.
Playing for other people is where the confidence shows up.
We hold a recital 0 times a year. Replace this.

Questions people ask before they join.
What if we don't own an instrument yet?
You can use the school's instrument at the start. Replace this if that isn't true.
How old do they need to be?
Yes. Book a trial whenever you like.
If we miss a lesson, can we move it?
Yes, if you tell us in time. Replace this with your real rule.
Easy to reach after work, or after school.
